title: Godot Crashes Periodically When Stopping Game Run
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.4 all versions

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Single-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 7 3800XT 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

Simply put, Godot crashes periodically when I attempt to either stop my game run from the Editor, or click the game window close button (X), or attempt to stop the game via stopping the Visual Studio run of the game.  It is random no matter which way.  This latest happened when I clicked my Game's Quit button.
